tcp_port.description: The TCP port number on which the USB/IP server listens for client connections.

log_to_syslog.description: If true, logs messages to the system syslog instead of stderr.

debug.description: If true, enables verbose debug logging.

auto_bind_busids.description: List of USB bus IDs (e.g., '1-1') to automatically bind to the usbip-host driver and make available for export.
